plan.title: Plan Your Adventure
plan.description: Let us help you plan the perfect Kalaw adventure. Find essential tips below, or contact our concierge for personalized assistance.

notices.howToBook: How to Book: All tours and activities can be arranged through our Lead Concierge at the front desk. We recommend booking at least 24 hours in advance.
notices.whatToBring: What to Bring: Comfortable walking shoes, a hat, sunscreen, a light jacket, and a reusable water bottle are recommended for all outdoor activities.
notices.privateTours: Private & Custom Tours: Want a unique experience? Our concierge can work with you to create a personalized itinerary.
notices.cancellations: Cancellations: A fee may apply for tours canceled less than 24 hours in advance. Please contact our concierge for details.
notices.healthFitness: Health & Fitness: Some tours require moderate physical fitness. For your safety, please inform our concierge of any health concerns prior to booking.
notices.pricing: Pricing: Prices are "starting from" and per person, generally including a guide and water. Meals and entrance fees are extra unless specified. Please confirm details upon booking.
notices.weather: Weather: Outdoor activities depend on suitable weather. In case of severe weather, our concierge will gladly assist with rescheduling or finding a safe alternative.

location.title: Location
location.heading: Our Home, Kalaw
location.paragraph1: Kalaw is more than a destination; it's a feeling. It's the crisp, pine-scented air of the Shan Highlands, the gentle pace of life, and the lingering charm of its colonial-era villas. A town where misty mornings give way to sunlit afternoons, perfect for exploration or quiet contemplation.
location.paragraph2: We chose this enchanting town as our home because we believe in its power to soothe and inspire. The Evergreen Hill was built to be a reflection of Kalaw's soul—a place that honors its natural beauty and timeless heritage while offering a sanctuary of modern comfort. We invite you to experience Kalaw not just as a tourist, but as our cherished guest.
location.address: The Evergreen Hill, Kalaw, No. 10, Pinewood Road, Ward (3), Kalaw, Shan State, Myanmar
location.directions: You can get directions on Google Maps

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.storyTitle: The Story of The Evergreen Hill
ourStory.storyP1: Our story begins not with bricks and mortar, but with a deep affection for Kalaw. We were captivated by its tranquil hills, the crisp scent of pine in the air, and the timeless charm of its colonial past. We dreamed of creating a place that wasn't just a hotel, but a true sanctuary where others could experience this unique serenity.
ourStory.storyP2: Inspired by the region's rich colonial heritage, The Evergreen Hill was born from a vision to honor this elegant past while embracing the comforts of modern luxury. Every detail, from the classic architectural lines to the locally sourced materials, was thoughtfully chosen to create a space that feels both grand and intuitively welcoming.
ourStory.storyP3: Today, The Evergreen Hill stands as a testament to that dream. It is more than a building on a hill; it is a backdrop for your stories, a haven for your peace of mind, and our heartfelt invitation to you to discover the soul of Kalaw. Welcome to our story.
ourStory.hospitalityP1: We believe true hospitality is not found in grand gestures, but in the quiet, sincere details. It's in the warmth of a genuine smile, the thoughtful anticipation of your needs, and the creation of a space where you feel not just welcomed, but truly at peace.
ourStory.hospitalityP2: Our philosophy is simple: to be your serene home in the Shan hills. We are dedicated to providing intuitive, heartfelt service that allows you to disconnect from the world and reconnect with what truly matters. Your comfort, your memories, and your sense of tranquility are the true measures of our success.
